headline: EVERY BEACH HOUSE ON THIS BOARD WAS RE-READ AGAIN THIS EVENING AND SIXTEEN OF SEVENTEEN CAME BACK ACTIVE AT EXACTLY THE SAME PRICE — a full weekend with zero movement.
